name: juliana-manduca
description: Portal institucional e área de clientes de Juliana Manduca.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @juliana/contracts && npm run build -w @juliana/api && npm run build -w @juliana/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @juliana/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @juliana/api" "npm run dev -w @juliana/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:biome && npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:architecture
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @juliana/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @juliana/api && npm run typecheck -w @juliana/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @juliana/contracts && npm run test -w @juliana/contracts && npm run test -w @juliana/api && npm run test -w @juliana/web
